name: BUNKER
variant: Die-cast aluminium IP65 bulkhead with 4CCT selectable colour temperature for robust exterior applications.
overview: The Bunker is a die-cast aluminium IP65 bulkhead engineered for exterior and semi-exterior environments. Its 4CCT switch provides four selectable colour temperatures, while the aluminium body dissipates heat and resists impact better than polycarbonate alternatives. A tamper-resistant construction suits public and semi-public installations.
features: Suitable for public and semi-public areas
